sql: SELECT [department] AS [department], COALESCE(SUM([salary]), 0) AS [salary_sum], AVG([age]) AS [age_avg] FROM [employees] GROUP BY [department] ORDER BY CASE WHEN AVG([age]) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, AVG([age]) ASC, CASE WHEN [department] IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, [department] ASC OFFSET @p1 ROWS FETCH NEXT @p2 ROWS ONLY
